inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Age >= 55 years and one year or more of amenorrhea.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Age >= 55 years and one year or more of amenorrhea.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Age < 55 years and one year or more of amenorrhea, with estradiol < 20 pg/ml
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Age < 55 years and one year or more of amenorrhea, with estradiol < 20 pg/ml

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Histologically confirmed metastatic or unresectable (not amenable to curative therapy) breast cancer.

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Preferred receptor testing is obtained from a metastatic site, but can be from the primary breast or axilla biopsy as long as this is most recent biopsy.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Has confirmed HER2 negative breast cancer.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Has confirmed HER2 negative breast cancer.

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: HER2 testing by IHC as 0 or 1+.

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Negative by in situ hybridization (FISH/CISH/SISH) defined as Her2/CEP17 ratio <2 and for single probe assessment a HER2 copy number <6).

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: PIK3CA mutation identified via local testing from tumor tissue or blood.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Has at least one measurable lesion as per RECIST 1.1 criteria within 28 days prior to registration.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Has at least one measurable lesion as per RECIST 1.1 criteria within 28 days prior to registration.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: If no measurable disease is present, then at least one predominantly lytic bone lesion must be present, within 28 days prior to registration.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: If no measurable disease is present, then at least one predominantly lytic bone lesion must be present, within 28 days prior to registration.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Patients with no measurable disease and only one predominantly lytic bone lesion that has been previously irradiated are eligible if there is documented evidence of disease progression of the bone lesion after irradiation.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Patients with no measurable disease and only one predominantly lytic bone lesion that has been previously irradiated are eligible if there is documented evidence of disease progression of the bone lesion after irradiation.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Has received at least one line of therapy with an endocrine therapy or endocrine therapy combination with other agents in the metastatic setting.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Has received at least one line of therapy with an endocrine therapy or endocrine therapy combination with other agents in the metastatic setting.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Must have received endocrine therapy (aromatase inhibitor or fulvestrant as single agent or in combination with other agents) as last line of therapy with progressive disease, as determined by treating physician.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Must have received endocrine therapy (aromatase inhibitor or fulvestrant as single agent or in combination with other agents) as last line of therapy with progressive disease, as determined by treating physician.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: No more than two prior lines of endocrine therapy or endocrine therapy combinations in the metastatic setting. Transition from one nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitor to a second nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitor due to tolerance will only count as one line of endocrine therapy. Combination therapy will be considered one line even if one of the agents is discontinued and the other continued.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: No more than two prior lines of endocrine therapy or endocrine therapy combinations in the metastatic setting. Transition from one nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitor to a second nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitor due to tolerance will only count as one line of endocrine therapy. Combination therapy will be considered one line even if one of the agents is discontinued and the other continued.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Patient must have received treatment with a CDK4/6 inhibitor for breast cancer in the metastatic setting.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Patient must have received treatment with a CDK4/6 inhibitor for breast cancer in the metastatic setting.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: CDK4/6 inhibitor discontinuation due to intolerance or reasons other than progression is allowed.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: CDK4/6 inhibitor discontinuation due to intolerance or reasons other than progression is allowed.

inclusion_criteria.raw_criterion: Demonstrate adequate organ function as defined in the protocol; all screening labs to be obtained within 28 days prior to registration.
inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Demonstrate adequate organ function as defined in the protocol; all screening labs to be obtained within 28 days prior to registration.

inclusion_criteria.validated_criterion: Adequate forms of contraception include: total abstinence, surgery intended to prevent pregnancy (defined as hysterectomy, bilateral oophorectomy or bilateral tubal ligation), non-hormonal IUD, or condom/occlusive cap with spermicidal foam/gel/film/cream/suppository).
